name: tmux-pair
description: Spawn writer/reviewer agent pairs (or writer/reviewer/orchestrator triples) in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Each agent runs in its own pane and talks to its peer through a small Python helper. Includes a 4-gate workflow (Clarify, Plan-Check, Implementation Loop, Final-Verify) with scoped plugin-agents for the gates (gate-2-plan-check on Sonnet, gate-3-verifier on Haiku, gate-3-code-reviewer on Sonnet, RECON via built-in Explore on Haiku), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, --effort flag in boot-command, and a model-aware compact-watcher with /compact [focus] support.
